title: Say Yes - Do No
subtitle: A site for AI resistance tactics, reclaiming agency and organising for better technology. “They all say ‘yes’, but they do ‘no’. That has to be it. There’s no other way to explain these figures. If they would do ‘yes’, the figures would have improved by now. [sigh] It would be easier if they would just say ‘no’. Then you could have a conversation about it [staring blankly].” (Anon.)
